concept: Место: городок Дикого Запада в свой лучший день — шериф следит за порядком, в салуне играет пианино, поезд везёт новичков и золото в банк.

cards.label: Sheriff Star
cards.key_features: exactly six points, each point ending in a small round ball; a plain smooth round center with no text or engraving
cards.pose: The star is tilted diagonally with one point toward the upper right

cards.label: Spurs
cards.object: pair of cowboy boots with spurs
cards.scene: boots standing on a plain floor
cards.key_features: pointed toes, stacked heels, decorative curved stitching on the tall shafts, star-shaped golden spur wheels on the heels
cards.pose: Both boots stand side by side in 3/4 view, the spur of the front boot clearly visible

cards.label: Stetson
cards.object: cowboy hat with a curled brim and a hatband
cards.story_detail: a small feather tucked into the hatband
cards.key_features: tall pinched crown with a dent on top, wide brim curled up at both sides, a dark brown hatband
cards.pose: The hat is tilted diagonally, seen slightly from above and from the front so the crown dent and the curled brim both read

cards.label: Honky-Tonk
cards.story_detail: a lit candle in a small brass holder standing on top
cards.key_features: a row of white piano keys with small black keys, an open music stand, two short carved front legs
cards.pose: The piano is turned in 3/4 view with the keyboard toward the viewer; we look very slightly up at it

cards.label: Swing Doors
cards.object: pair of saloon swinging half-doors in a simple wooden door frame
cards.key_features: two short louvered half-doors hanging in the middle of the frame, open gap above and below them, one door swinging slightly open
cards.pose: Frontal 3/4 view at eye level, the right door swung slightly toward the viewer

cards.label: Bank Safe
cards.object: old-fashioned bank safe with its heavy door open
cards.scene: open safe on a plain floor
cards.story_detail: a neat stack of gold bars inside
cards.key_features: thick open door with a big round dial and a wheel handle, golden trim, short sturdy feet
cards.pose: The safe is in 3/4 view with the open door on the right, gold bars clearly visible inside

cards.label: Lucky Shoe
cards.story_detail: a small four-leaf clover tucked into it
cards.key_features: U shape with the open end pointing up, a row of nail holes along the curve
cards.pose: The horseshoe is tilted diagonally about 20 degrees, open end up

cards.label: Saguaro
cards.scene: warm orange desert sand with a red mesa far away
cards.story_detail: one big blooming flower on top
cards.key_features: a tall ribbed column with two arms curving upward, tiny pale spines
cards.pose: The cactus towers up in the center from a low camera, its arms framing the sky

cards.label: Iron Horse
cards.scene: a railway curving through a green prairie
cards.story_detail: a big puffy cloud of white steam from the chimney
cards.key_features: tall funnel chimney, cow-catcher at the front, big red spoked wheels, golden bands on the boiler; no black or grey large areas
cards.pose: The locomotive comes along a curving track toward the viewer, its front big in the foreground

cards.label: Saloon
cards.object: two-story wooden saloon building with a balcony
cards.scene: a warm golden dusty main street
cards.story_detail: a blank wooden sign board above the balcony
cards.key_features: tall false-front facade, a covered porch with posts, a balcony railing, swinging doors at the entrance; no letters on the sign
cards.pose: Low-angle 3/4 view of the facade, the porch and doors closest to the camera
